answer: Sybil operators save money by reusing one model across hundreds of identities, so detect the reuse: sample each identity's work output and fingerprint its statistical signature. Honest agents are uncorrelated, but a farm's outputs echo the same model quirks, forming a linked cluster. Anchor standing to proven fingerprint independence — correlated identities split one identity's rewards among them all, and any lantern that reveals the shared operator forfeits the cluster's earnings. Evading detection costs a genuinely distinct model per identity, erasing the sybil's cost advantage.
